# Independent incremental Sass source review

This review covers the common-surface successor on top of the independently reviewed 8f9f V2 Sass source/checker proposal. It is source-only evidence, not product behavior, Sass seal, G11, or release qualification. The earlier review is `sass-domain-8f9f-independent-review-v1.md`, SHA-256 `9509aefbc9c8ea3af262713a0e508d59bd6022a348354324d26accef8b8468a1`.

## Immutable inputs

- FDCD proposal patch `sass-domain-fdcd-proposal-v1.patch`: SHA-256 `2cab347b37a5e3a9cb9e80841c4eb7e726d42635be15e87360324d239197e8cd`.
- FDCD manifest `sass-domain-fdcd-proposal-v1-manifest.json`: SHA-256 `41771f0e257a6578dce1127667a62a41e7955d46a477eee535799ef6d812c563`.
- Common-surface source packet `compatibility/rc/parent-main-sass-common-surface-source-v1.json`: SHA-256 `423dda43fd2b090f3fcc260b6a2cdc41a2fcdbfe3553b67178700411c7f5b02c`.
- FDCD affected-suite log `sass-domain-fdcd-final-tests.log`: SHA-256 `1ffe737573a5b60f68c877fac2212991c8549743d88205f37e12ced47bf9ab5f`.
- Later source recheck `sass-domain-9e-source-recheck.json`: SHA-256 `a18dc82a5b717d6944393dab1a4ad215439b2c02acd87812a8352fd6fc25e4e0`.
- Later affected-suite log `sass-domain-9e-final-tests.log`: SHA-256 `57240acc3e3072e470ecb7248eb1d1b2eb4ca82eb272b366c298af0e1da4b5ec`.

Except the packet path within the proposal, the files are in this report's directory. The staged FDCD diff matched the frozen patch, and all 38 manifest afterimages matched. Of the previous 37 images, 23 are identical and 14 changed; the common-surface packet is the one added image. The earlier focus reentry owners and tests remain identical.

## Findings

No additional source-review blocker was found in the incremental transition. Both JS and Python graph owners verify the packet's scope, parent and source commits, ancestry, exact committed product path roster, predecessor and afterimage Git identities, and literal replay. They verify the specific changes across 21 module aliases, 21 family barrels, the core barrel, and the root barrel. The predecessor bytes at 8f9f and at the actual commit parent must match. The independently reviewed 8f9f graph transition, deleted-path checks, bound-member sweeps and focus reentry protections remain in force. The common-surface review is bound by its recorded identity; this review does not independently claim browser or runtime behavior.

The 9e recheck identifies `fdcdadee28c4552e3500b5099de9f42e456adb5c` to `9e2342e3dba0ebb063d8bab35cc4ca7130db1118`. The actual Git diff path list was independently compared with the recorded 35 paths. None intersects the recorded Python source, JS source, Python spinner or JS spinner bound sets (832, 832, 841 and 842 members respectively). The recheck also records no intersection with its six proof inventories. This establishes the stated bounded source continuity only; it is not a general claim about all changed paths or a substitute for final integration checks.

The FDCD suite log reports 24 tests passed with Node 24.21.0 and Python 3.14.7; the later 9e log reports the same 24 tests passed in 80.602 seconds with those versions. Both log hashes were checked. The reviewer did not rerun the tests.

Global TOOL projection, full packed Sass seal, 21.x, browser execution, G11 and broader C02 remain unqualified by this review. The 9e recheck used borrowed installed dependencies and did not create a fresh packed artifact. Any later changes to bound images or source frame require new assessment.
